landing.heroTitle: Your learning and work journal, with a tutor that never makes things up
landing.heroSubtitle: Log classes, meetings, documents and tasks. Ask your AI tutor anything: it answers only from your own notes and cites every source.
landing.f1Body: Organize everything by subject or project, with colors, filters and archiving.
landing.f2Body: Daily entries with tags, dates and attachments (PDFs, images, audio) that are indexed automatically.
landing.f3Body: Answers come strictly from your context. Each claim is cited as [S1], [S2]… and the quotes are verified.
landing.f4Body: Available in English and Spanish, and built to add more languages easily.
landing.how1: Write or upload what you learn or decide.
landing.how2: It is chunked and embedded securely in your private space.
landing.how3: Ask the tutor: if your notes don't cover it, it says so instead of guessing.
landing.footer: Powered by Supabase and OpenAI. Your data stays isolated to your account.
